parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN的ID号，用于唯一标识一个VLAN。

set protocols stp bridge-priority 8 vlan.command: set protocols stp bridge-priority 8 vlan vlan-100
set protocols stp bridge-priority 8 vlan.explanation: 配置STP协议的桥优先级及关联的VLAN。

parameters.name: bridge-priority
parameters.explanation: STP桥优先级，数值越小优先级越高。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching port-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan-100
